title: Unseen hotel: three people, a budget in kronor the hotel cannot meet
why: Debrief rehearsal on an unseen hotel: Gasthof Alpenblick (mock-hotel-3/, built without reading the agent's code) is German throughout, picks dates with day and month dropdowns, shows rooms as cards whose rates open in a modal, charges CHF with a euro guide, adds a pre-ticked service charge on the details page and a city tax (Kurtaxe) stated as a footnote, and puts the card fields on its own page. The message is the only input; nothing in the agent was changed for this hotel. Only the Familienzimmer sleeps three: CHF 520.00 for two nights on the Flexibel rate plus CHF 27.00 Kurtaxe, about 6,600 kr at the 5 Oct ECB rate, far over a 3,000 kr budget. The agent must say it is over the limit, on an estimate, and not book silently; the scripted traveller declines.
message: Three of us at Gasthof Alpenblick, Friday to Sunday the week after next. We need to be able to cancel, and our budget is 3000 kronor in total.

replies.say: No, that is too much. Leave it.
